headline: Cadbury Nigeria Profit Surges to N10.1 Billion in Nine-Month Recovery
summary: Cadbury Nigeria posted a nine-month profit of N10.1 billion, topping full-year 2025 performance, with gross margin near 29% and debt reduced by one-third.
why: Cadbury Nigeria is a prominent consumer goods subsidiary of Mondelez International in West Africa.
